question: 19 men and 13 women can complete a piece of work in 12 days, while 17 men and 9 women can complete the same work in 14 days. The work of how many women is equivalent to that of one man?
solution:
**Given:**

19 men + 13 women → 12 days

17 men + 9 women → 14 days

**Formula Used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

Efficiency ∝ 1 ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ (19M + 13W) × 12 = (17M + 9W) × 14

⇒ 228M + 156W = 238M + 126W

⇒ 156W − 126W = 238M − 228M

⇒ 30W = 10M

⇒ 1M = 3W

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**
